summary: Flex Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled Nasdaq registrant, filed an 8-K disclosing a $2.0B private placement of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock in its spin-off vehicle, Axiom Solutions International, Inc., ahead of the planned Q1 2027 separation of Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure business. General Catalyst and other investors will purchase 200,000 shares at $10,000 per share. Flex guarantees Axiom's redemption obligation if the Spin-Off is not completed by December 31, 2027, priced at a per-share premium to Stated Value. The filing follows the September 3, 2026 EPC Power Corp. acquisition, which is also expected to close in Q4 2026 and be folded into Axiom before the Spin-Off. The transaction may be satisfied in cash or Flex Ordinary Shares, subject to Flex's approval. The structural overhang is the $2B preferred obligation and the December 31, 2027 backstop, which creates a hard deadline for the separation and a potential repurchase liability if the spin is delayed or blocked. Watch for regulatory approvals, EPC Power closing risk, and any change in spin timing.
